_doc: SIMCODE v2 models (the shipped models; read through simcode.config.model_set(name), which also takes the path of a model folder with a model.json). File names are relative to the models directory. One model = detector + emitter network of pass 1 (detector, emitter), of pass 2 (detector_pass2, emitter_pass2), their solve calibrations and the selection-aware sigma rescale. cal_sim / cal_sim_pass2 = simulation sigma calibrations (no real-data mismatch multiplier); cal_real / cal_real_pass2 = the ones used on real movies; sig_u = sigma rescale per pass (table.build_table sig_u), pass 1 then pass 2. All models are PSF-matched: trained on one averaged in-situ PSF (psf).

_production._doc: How the paper's SIMCODE v2 tables are made: python -m simcode.run --dataset <name> (= --movie, --calib, --model and --crop of the entry, the calibration kind below (cal_real), and the run.py defaults: pass 2, the model's sigma rescale). The tables are locs_p1.hdf5 / locs_p2.hdf5; the paper's selection (max(sigma_x, sigma_y) <= 12 nm on the rows with p >= 0.63 inside the crop) is applied at load: simcode.dataset.Dataset.select. Movies are relative to the data root.
_production._selection_doc: main selection (user decision 2026-11-13): rows with p >= 0.63 inside the crop and calibrated max(sigma_x, sigma_y) <= 12 nm (simcode.table.select, Dataset.select, SIGMA_MAX_NM; since 2026-11-15 applied when a table is loaded, no subset files). Until 2026-11-13 it was the per-tile rule u <= 0.45. Study: analysis/selection_global, out/selection_global.

20nM_2._doc: 2026-11-15: processed with m25 (trained on the 2.5 nM v2 PSF) and the movie's own v2 calibration

m1809._doc: PSF-matched model for the 1809/2 movie (averaged 1809/2 in-situ PSF; adopted 2026-11-11; production out/paper2/1809_2/v2_matched); also the model of the realistic-PSF paper simulations | 2026-11-14: retrained with the 3D head (z output; out/z3d), files in m1809/; the previous 2D model is the folder archive_2d/m1809/ (not referenced by any config) | 2026-11-14: GENERIC pass 2 (generic illumination-pattern training; accepts any measured two-orientation pattern), pass 1 unchanged; the dedicated pass 2 is the folder archive_p2dedicated/m1809/ (not referenced by any config) | 2026-11-15: retrained on the in-situ PSF + camera v2 (out/psf_v2: gain 0.4256 e/ADU, vectorial PSF v2, training heights from the calibration); the previous model is the folder archive_psf_v1/m1809/ (not referenced)

m25._doc: PSF-matched model for the 2.5 nM / 2 movie (averaged 2.5 nM in-situ PSF; production out/paper2/2.5nM_2/v2_matched) | 2026-11-14: retrained with the 3D head (z output; out/z3d), files in m25/; the previous 2D model is the folder archive_2d/m25/ (not referenced by any config) | 2026-11-14: GENERIC pass 2 (generic illumination-pattern training; accepts any measured two-orientation pattern), pass 1 unchanged; the dedicated pass 2 is the folder archive_p2dedicated/m25/ (not referenced by any config) | 2026-11-15: retrained on the in-situ PSF + camera v2 (out/psf_v2: gain 0.4256 e/ADU, vectorial PSF v2, training heights from the calibration); pass-2 detector = generic fine-tuned from a dedicated (SIMCODE-pattern) detector (out/generic_mix, out/psf_v2/eval/m25v2/det2); also the model of the 20 nM / 2 movie; the previous model is the folder archive_psf_v1/m25/ (not referenced)

g13._doc: PSF-matched model for the Gaussian sigma 1.3 px PSF (preprint-condition simulations; m1809 recipe + --dens 0.0005,0.06, --tau 3,80; 2026-11-12) | 2026-11-14: retrained with the 3D head (z output; out/z3d), files in g13/; the previous 2D model is the folder archive_2d/g13/ (not referenced by any config) | 2026-11-14: GENERIC pass 2 (generic illumination-pattern training; accepts any measured two-orientation pattern), pass 1 unchanged; the dedicated pass 2 is the folder archive_p2dedicated/g13/ (not referenced by any config)
